body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A method of operation of a fleet of robotsrobot,the method performed by the robot, the method comprising:
identifying, by a first robot in the fleet of robots, a set of candidate actions that may be performed by the a first robot;
collecting, by the first robot and for each candidate action of the set of candidate actions, a respective set of ancillary data;
transmitting, by the first robot, a request for instructions to a tele-operation system, the tele-operation system communicatively coupled to the fleet of robotsrobot, the request for the instructions which includes each candidate action of the set of candidate actions and each respective set of ancillary data;
receiving, by the first robot, the instructions from the tele-operation system;
executing, by the first robot, the instructions; and
updating, by the first robot, a control model of the first robot, based at least in part on each candidate action of the set of candidate actions, each respective set of ancillary data, and the instructions, to increase a level of autonomy of the firstrobot; and
updatinq, by a second robot in the fleet of robots, a control model of the second robot, based at least in part based on the update made to the control model of the first robot, to increase a level of autonomy of the second robot.
2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, the first robot comprising one or more sensors, wherein the identifying a set of candidate actions that may be performed by the firstrobot includes sensing, by the one or more sensors, at least one of an external event or an external condition and identifying the set of candidate actions in response to sensing the at least one of an external event or an external condition.
3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving, by the first robot and from the tele-operation system, an objective to be completed by the firstrobot, wherein the identifying a set of candidate actions that may be performed by the
first robot includes identifying a set of candidate actions that may be performed by the first robot in furtherance of the objective.
4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3, wherein the transmitting a request for instructions to a tele-operation system includes transmitting the request for instructions to the tele-operation system in response to determining the first robot is unable to select a candidate action of the set of candidate actions to perform in furtherance of the objective.
5. (Currently Amended) The method claim 4, further comprising scoringJ;>_y the first robot, each candidate action of the set of candidate actions, wherein the scoring each candidate action of the set of candidate actions includes assigning a respective probability to each candidate action, the respective probability being based at least in part on a respective expectation of progress, achievable by each candidate action, towards the objective.
6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5, further comprising by the first robot, each candidate action in an order of preference, the order of preference being based at least in part on the respective probability of each candidate action.SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.140.537
7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, wherein the transmitting a request for instructions to a tele-operation system, the request for the instructions which includes each candidate action of the set of candidate actions and each respective set of ancillary data includes transmitting a request for instructions to a tele-operation system, the transmitted request for the instructions which includes each respective probability and the order of preference.
8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, further comprising determining, by the first robot, whether a respective probability meets a predetermined probability criterion.
9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, further comprising determining, by the first robot, whether a difference between a first respective probability and a second respective probability meets a predetermined difference criterion.
10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, the first robot being a semi- autonomous robot characterized by a level of autonomy, the level of autonomy being determined at least in part by the control model, the method further comprising comparing the level of autonomy of the first robot to a threshold level of autonomy, the threshold level of autonomy above which the first robot is operable to autonomously select a candidate action of the set of candidate actions to perform, wherein the transmitting, by the first robot, a request for instructions to a tele-operation system includes transmitting the request for instructions to the tele-operation system in response to determining the level of autonomy of the first robot is lower than the threshold level of autonomy.
11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, further comprising, in response to determining the level of autonomy of the firstrobot meets or exceeds the threshold level of autonomy, performing, by the first robot, one of the candidate actions of the set of candidate actions.
12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, further comprising receiving, by the first robot and from the tele-operation system, an objective to be completed by the first robot, wherein the identifying a set of candidate actions that may be performed by thefirst robot includes identifying a set of candidate actions that may be performed by the first robot in furtherance of the objective.
13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising determining, by the first robot, the threshold level of autonomy, wherein the determining the threshold level of autonomy includes assigning a respective probability to each candidate action, the respective probability being based at least in part on a respective expectation of progress, achievable by each candidate action, towards the objective.
14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising by the first robot, each candidate action in an order of preference, the order of preference being based at least in part on the respective probability.SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.140.537
15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14, wherein the determining the level of autonomy of the first robot is lower than the threshold level of autonomy includes
determining the respective probability of each candidate action in the set of candidate actions fails to satisfy at least one predetermined criterion.
16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, the first robot comprising one or more sensors and a data repository, the collecting, by the first robot and for each candidate action of the set of candidate actions, a respective set of ancillary data includes at least one of collecting a first subset of the respective set of ancillary data by the one or more sensors or extracting a second subset of the respective set of ancillary data from the data repository.
17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the transmittingsby the first robot, a request for instructions to a tele-operation system includes transmitting a request for the tele-operation system to determine which candidate action the first robot should perform.
18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, the first robot comprising a motion actuator, wherein executing the instructions includes causing, by the motion actuator, the first robot to execute a movement.
19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the updating.,_by the first robot, a control model, based at least in part on each candidate action of the set of candidate actions, each respective set of ancillary data, and the instructions includes increasing a level of autonomy of the first robot from a first level of autonomy to a second level of autonomy, the second level of autonomy being higher than the first level of autonomy.
20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising identifying, by the first robot, an objective to be completed by the firstrobot, wherein the identifying a set of candidate actions that may be performed by the firstrobot includes identifying a set of candidate actions that may be performed by the firstrobot in furtherance of the objective.
